verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of any HRIS or payroll integration (Gusto, Rippling, or similar) that syncs new hires or terminations into Eqvista's stakeholder records. The only data-ingestion paths documented are spreadsheet import and white-glove migration from other cap-table providers, which are one-off imports, not an automated recurring sync. HRIS sync is a fair question for cap-table software, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this "none".

support.subject: As an ops user, stakeholders sync from my HRIS/payroll system (e.g. Gusto, Rippling) so new hires and terminations flow into equity records automatically
